name: Leg Press Calf Press
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Stand on the edge of a step, then rise onto your toes.
start_cue.hi: Step ke kinare khade ho, phir toes par upar aao.

good.en: Good. You came up onto your toes fully.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aap poore toes par aaye.

fix.en: Push up higher onto your toes.

above.en: That is high enough. Do not roll your ankle.
above.hi: Itna hi kaafi hai. Ankle mat mudo.

almost.en: Push up higher onto your toes.

good.en: Good. You let the heel drop fully.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapne heel poora neeche kiya.

fix.en: Let your heel drop below the step for a stretch.
fix.hi: Heel ko step se neeche jaane do, stretch ke liye.

almost.en: Let your heel drop below the step for a stretch.
almost.hi: Heel ko step se neeche jaane do, stretch ke liye.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the way down. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

below.en: Too fast. Control the way down. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
